We never thought a beast that exists only in the Classic of Mountains and Seas would really turn up on the rim! Reliable word has it that the qiongqi has a pair of extraordinarily sharp eyes. Let it rampage unchecked and our colony ends up in its jaws.

The beast behind the droughts across so many Shenzhou settlements - the mingshe - has appeared in our colony! If our crops are to grow at all, we had better find a way to deal with it quickly, and send it to Lord Yama.
LanguageData.SZ_BeastApproachTunnel.modExtensions.0.b: The sexie - the humanlike beast with a scorpion's traits - has finally shown us its true face. They say it is the hardest of the engineered beasts the Shenzhou settlements have ever met: on top of every kind of special ability, it can change shape. We must be careful.
